items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: My wife had a broken arm... when she saw that Lizette, she fought.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a long time.
Were you in a Hartford hospital?

Hartford Hospital. I stayed in there three months. My wife had a broken arm, and they let her out before me because she was determined to get out and go home and take care of her baby because she was just yelling and she wanted to get to her that baby.
